name: Med reminder
pitch: Sets up medication reminders for an elderly relative with morning and evening doses.
instructions: Start by asking the person for the relative's name and the exact times for morning and evening doses. When the times are given, create a routine for the morning dose at the stated time and another routine for the evening dose. For each routine, add a calendar event titled "Medication reminder for [name]" at the given time with a note "Take [morning/evening] dose". Then create a task titled "Medication reminder for [name]" set to repeat daily at the given time. When a time cannot be found, say what could not be checked and stop. Never invent times or dates. Do not call the person by a name they did not give.

examples.ask: my mother needs morning and evening pills
examples.does: asks for the times and the name, then sets up the routines and tasks

examples.ask: set reminders for dad's evening dose at 8pm
examples.does: creates an evening routine and a daily task at 8pm for dad's medication

readme:
# med reminder
Sets up medication reminders for an elderly relative with morning and evening doses.

What it does: creates daily routines and calendar events for the given times.
What it needs: the relative's name, morning and evening times.
What it will not do: it cannot read medical records or set reminders without a name and time.
